Privacy policy

Updated November 19, 2026

QuanToot is an independent Mastodon client developed by BobMaster. This policy covers the iOS and Android apps and this website.

Data on your device

QuanToot stores your selected server, app preferences, and cached timelines and media on the device. Your Mastodon session and access token are stored with OS-provided secure storage. The app has no advertising, analytics, or tracking SDKs. QuanToot does not operate a social network or collect this local app data on a developer backend.

Servers, content, and downloads

QuanToot communicates with the Mastodon server you select. That operator may process your IP address, account data, posts, media, interactions, and activity according to its policies. Media hosts and linked sites may receive normal connection information when content is loaded. On Android, the optional update check requests release information and packages from the Forgejo host.

Photos and media

The app uses the system picker for media you select to attach or upload. A chosen item is sent to your server when you upload it. If you explicitly save a file to the photo library, QuanToot requests the access needed for that action.

Your choices and retention

Use Accounts → Remove account to remove a saved session and its token. Clear cached media in app settings. Removing the app clears its app container; iOS Keychain items can outlive an uninstall, so remove saved accounts before uninstalling if you want to clear their credentials. For permanent account deletion and server-held data, use Settings → Delete Mastodon account or contact your instance. Account deletion instructions.

Website and support email

This site uses session storage for its language selector and contains no analytics scripts. Its hosting provider may process routine request information needed to deliver pages and protect the service. When you email support, BobMaster receives your email address, message, and any information you choose to include, and keeps it as needed to respond or handle follow-up. You can request deletion by email.

Contact

QuanToot 是 BobMaster 开发的独立 Mastodon 客户端。本政策适用于 iOS、Android 应用和此网站。

保存在设备上的数据

QuanToot 会在设备上保存所选实例、应用偏好、时间线和媒体缓存。Mastodon 登录会话和访问令牌由系统安全存储保护。应用不包含广告、分析或追踪 SDK，开发者未运营社交网络或收集这些本地应用数据的后端。

实例、内容与下载

应用直接与所选的 Mastodon 实例通信。实例运营者可能按其政策处理你的 IP 地址、账号资料、帖子、媒体、互动和活动记录。加载远程媒体或访问链接时，相关网站可能收到常规连接信息。在 Android 上主动检查更新时，应用会向 Forgejo 请求版本信息或安装包。

照片和媒体

应用通过系统选择器读取你明确选择的媒体。上传时，所选文件会发送给你的实例。主动保存文件到照片图库时，应用会按需请求相应权限。

数据清理与账号删除

可在账号 → 移除账号删除保存的会话和令牌，在应用设置中清理媒体缓存。卸载应用会清除应用容器，但 iOS 钥匙串数据可能在卸载后保留，如需删除登录凭据，请先在应用中移除账号。要永久删除账号及实例持有的数据，请使用设置 → 删除 Mastodon 账号或联系实例运营者。查看删除步骤。

网站与反馈邮件

网站使用会话存储记住语言选择，不加载分析脚本。托管服务可能处理提供页面和保护服务所需的常规请求数据。你主动发邮件时，BobMaster 会收到你的邮箱地址、邮件内容和附件，仅按处理反馈和后续沟通所需保留。你可通过邮件申请删除。
